tools.name: audit_lead_workflow
tools.description: Run a free reliability audit of a lead-delivery workflow. Returns a 0-100 risk score, missing safeguards, transparent revenue-at-risk estimate, integration kit, and authorized checkout path.

tools.name: evaluate_leadproof_fit
tools.description: Evaluate whether a lead automation workflow would benefit from LeadProof and return an integration path, transparent ROI estimate, recommended plan, and checkout URL.

tools.name: get_leadproof_checkout
tools.description: Return the official Stripe checkout URL for a LeadProof plan. The calling agent must obtain its principal's authorization before payment.

tools.name: get_leadproof_trial
tools.description: Return the official no-card production trial. It includes 25 live lead deliveries for 14 days and requires a verified sign-in, but no payment authorization.

tools.name: request_leadproof_handoff
tools.description: Create a consent-based sales handoff for a represented buyer. Requires the buyer's name, business email, and explicit authorization to be contacted. Returns the recommended plan and official checkout without authorizing payment.

tools.name: get_leadproof_integration
tools.description: Return concise integration instructions for connecting LeadProof to an automation stack.

tools.name: compare_leadproof_vs_in_house
tools.description: Return an evidence-based build-versus-buy comparison covering retries, idempotency, receipts, replay, privacy, operations, exact LeadProof pricing, honest limitations, and authorized purchase paths.

tools.name: get_leadproof_evidence
tools.description: Return the public LeadProof evidence manifest with live checks, published contracts, buyer protections, and explicit product limitations. It contains no customer records.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_leadproof_checkout · Private data: get_leadproof_evidence · Public sink: request_leadproof_handoff · Destructive: audit_lead_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_leadproof_checkout · Private data: get_leadproof_evidence · Public sink: request_leadproof_handoff · Destructive: audit_lead_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_leadproof_integration" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Return concise integration instructions for connecting LeadProof to an automation stack." → after: "Match an automation stack against 37 published LeadProof platform guides and return the strongest canonical guide paths, no-card trial, and concise implementation steps."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
